meta_data.base_class: Consult with professionals on integrating <device systems> - refers to different types of systems that require professional installation or integration.

tool_template.name: ConsultantFor_<class>Integration
tool_template.description: Consult with a professional for integrating <class>.

consultation_mode.description: Preferred mode of consultation (e.g., online, in-person).

device_list.description: List of devices or components in the <class> to be discussed during consultation.

include_follow_up.description: Whether to include follow-up sessions after initial consultation.

priority_support.description: Whether to request priority support for urgent <class> integration.

integration_schedule.description: Preferred schedule for the integration of the <class>.

budget_limit.description: Maximum budget allocated for the integration of the <class>.

integration_duration.description: Estimated duration in hours or days for the integration of the <class>.

access_requirements.description: Specific access requirements or constraints for integrating the <class>.

data_privacy_compliance.description: Whether the integration of the <class> requires compliance with data privacy regulations.
